# ARCC Media Production — llms.txt

> Professional photography and podcast studio in Bangalore, India.

## About

ARCC Media Production is a compact creative studio near Bannerghatta Main Road, Bangalore (560083), offering professional photography, video podcast recording, brand films, corporate shoots, event coverage, and post-production services. Established in 2021.

## Services

- **Photography:** Wedding, pre-wedding, fashion & editorial, product & e-commerce, corporate portraits, personal portraiture, campaign stills.
- **Film & Video:** Brand films, commercials & digital ads, corporate stories, music videos, YouTube formats, founder interviews.
- **Events:** Event photography, cinematic event films, multi-camera coverage, live streaming, conference & summit coverage, same-day social edits.
- **Creative:** Campaign concepts, scripts & treatments, storyboards, brand language, content systems, creative production direction.
- **Post-Production:** Offline & online edits, colour grading, motion graphics, sound design & mix, vertical social cutdowns, mastering & delivery.
- **Studio Rental:** Podcast recording, studio rental, product shoots, green screen setup, multi-camera interviews, lighting & sound support.

## Studio Rooms

1. **The Conversation Room** — 2–4 people, video podcast format.
2. **The Black Room** — Founder films, interviews.
3. **The Infinite** — Product, portrait, campaign (white infinity cyc).
4. **The Round Table** — Panels, community formats.

## Location
